visitLine: Call and visit to the Gold Coast
heroLede: New lines on the Gold Coast are the easiest time to build in a check on every pack. Here's what a camera check could look like on your filling line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every tub has its lid on, seated flat and closed. A lifted lid means a leak in the parcel and an unhappy customer.
labelLede: With more than 60 products, a moisturiser and a scalp cream can look much the same at line speed. The camera checks every pack carries the right label for the product, straight and intact.
codeLede: The batch and expiry code ties every pack back to its batch. The system reads the printed code on every pack and compares it with the product and batch set at changeover.
objectLede: Lid offcuts, glove pieces and loose parts can end up close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a carton.
